title: Thousands of ayahuasca users report meeting the same all-knowing goddess

tellings.quote: And they take Iawaska and they will meet a goddess down and and you have thousands of reports of people meeting this similar goddess being woman that automatically knows everything that's wrong with you

plain: Thousands of people who drink ayahuasca, a psychedelic brew used in the Amazon, report meeting the same goddess, a female being who instantly knows everything that is wrong with them. A researcher named Luke Caverns tells Michels this, passing on what others have reported. If true, it suggests the drug opens onto something shared rather than private visions.
